add.help: Add file contents to the index

all.help: Update the index not only where the working tree has a file matching <pathspec> but also where the index already has an entry

chmod.help: Override the executable bit of the added files

dry_run.help: Don't actually add the file(s), just show if they exist and/or will be ignored

edit.help: Open the diff vs. the index in an editor and let the user edit it

ignore_missing.help: This option can only be used together with --dry-run

intent_to_add.help: Record only the fact that the path will be added later

interactive.help: Add modified contents in the working tree interactively to the index

pathspec_from_file.help: Pathspec is passed in <file> instead of commandline args

unified.help: Generate diffs with <n> lines of context

ignore_other_worktrees.help: git checkout refuses when the wanted branch is already checked out or otherwise in use by another worktree

ignore_skip_worktree_bits.help: In sparse checkout mode, git checkout -- <path>..

inter_hunk_context.help: Show the context between diff hunks, up to the specified <number> of lines, thereby fusing hunks that are close to each other

l.help: Create the new branch's reflog; see git-branch(1) for details

no_track.help: Do not set up "upstream" configuration, even if the branch.autoSetupMerge configuration variable is true

orphan.help: Create a new unborn branch, named <new-branch>, started from <start-point> and switch to it

overwrite_ignore.help: Silently overwrite ignored files when switching branches

patch.help: Interactively select hunks in the difference between the <tree-ish> (or the index, if unspecified) and the working tree

pathspec_from_file.help: Pathspec is passed in <file> instead of commandline args

recurse_submodules.help: Using --recurse-submodules will update the content of all active submodules according to the commit recorded in the superproject

track.help: When creating a new branch, set up "upstream" configuration

unified.help: Generate diffs with <n> lines of context

all.help: Automatically stage files that have been modified and deleted, but new files you have not told Git about are not affected

allow_empty_message.help: Create a commit with an empty commit message without using plumbing commands like git-commit-tree(1)

branch.help: Show the branch and tracking info even in short-format

cleanup.help: Determine how the supplied commit message should be cleaned up before committing

date.help: Override the author date used in the commit

patch.help: Use the interactive patch selection interface to choose which changes to commit

unified.help: Generate diffs with <n> lines of context

basic_regexp.help: Consider the limiting patterns to be basic regular expressions; this is the default

color_moved.help: Moved lines of code are colored differently

date_order.help: Show no parents before all of its children are shown, but otherwise show commits in the commit timestamp order

dst_prefix.help: Show the given destination <prefix> instead of "b/"

exclude_hidden.help: Do not include refs that would be hidden by git-fetch, git-receive-pack or git-upload-pack by consulting the appropriate fetch.hideRefs, receive.hideRefs or uploadpack.hideRefs configuration along with transfer.hideRefs (see git-config(1))

expand_tabs.help: Perform a tab expansion (replace each tab with enough spaces to fill to the next display column that is a multiple of <n>) in the log message before showing it in the output

ext_diff.help: Allow an external diff helper to be executed

extended_regexp.help: Consider the limiting patterns to be extended regular expressions instead of the default basic regular expressions

find_copies.help: Detect copies as well as renames

find_object.help: Look for differences that change the number of occurrences of the specified object

find_renames.help: If generating diffs, detect and report renames for each commit

ignore_missing.help: Upon seeing an invalid object name in the input, pretend as if the bad input was not given

ignore_space_at_eol.help: Ignore changes in whitespace at EOL

ignore_space_change.help: Ignore changes in amount of whitespace

ignore_submodules.help: Ignore changes to submodules in the diff generation

indent_heuristic.help: Enable the heuristic that shifts diff hunk boundaries to make patches easier to read

inter_hunk_context.help: Show the context between diff hunks, up to the specified <number> of lines, thereby fusing hunks that are close to each other

line_prefix.help: Prepend an additional <prefix> to every line of output

m.help: Show diffs for merge commits in the default format

name_status.help: Show only the name(s) and status of each changed file

oneline.help: This is a shorthand for --pretty=oneline --abbrev-commit used together

output.help: Output to a specific file instead of stdout

patch.help: Generate patch (see the section called "GENERATING PATCH TEXT WITH -P")

reflog.help: Pretend as if all objects mentioned by reflogs are listed on the command line as <commit>

skip_to.help: Discard the files before the named <file> from the output (i.e

sparse.help: All commits in the simplified history are shown

stdin.help: In addition to getting arguments from the command line, read them from standard input as well

submodule.help: Specify how differences in submodules are shown

summary.help: Output a condensed summary of extended header information such as creations, renames and mode changes

t.help: Show the tree objects in the diff output

tags.help: Pretend as if all the refs in refs/tags are listed on the command line as <commit>

unified.help: Generate diffs with <n> lines of context instead of the usual three

inter_hunk_context.help: Show the context between diff hunks, up to the specified <number> of lines, thereby fusing hunks that are close to each other
